permit_authority.value: City of Sanger Building and Safety Division

permit_url.notes: Sanger's Building and Safety Division routes permit applications through its iWorQ citizen self-service portal; a dedicated solar-specific permitting page was not located this session, so the general online portal is cited here.

interconnection_url.notes: PG&E's own utility-wide Net Energy Metering (NEM) program page.

value.name: SGIP - Residential Solar and Storage Equity
value.administrator: Pacific Gas and Electric Company (PG&E), under the CPUC's Self-Generation Incentive Program
value.description: Storage incentive of $1,100/kWh paired with a solar incentive of $3,100/kW, funded via a $280 million CPUC-authorized statewide budget that opened for reservations June 2, 2025 and remains an active program per SGIP's own statewide announcements (most recently dated 2026-07-23). Administered across PG&E's entire distribution territory, which includes Sanger/Fresno County.
value.eligibility: PG&E, SCE, or SDG&E residential customers (general market tier)

battery_programs.notes: Reused as a utility-level fact already established for other IOU-territory records this session: the CPUC-administered SGIP program applies uniformly across the named utility's entire distribution territory, directly verified via SGIP's own site (selfgenca.com) / the CPUC's own SGIP program page, including a program-status announcement as recent as 2026-07-23 confirming the program remains active.

value.name: Checklist of expedited-review requirements, published on the City's website

required_documents.notes: Per Sanger Municipal Code Section 14-93(b)(1)-(2): the community development department develops a checklist of all requirements, published on the city's internet website; applicant may submit by personal, mailed, or electronic submittal. The code text itself does not itemize further documents beyond this checklist.

value: For a small residential rooftop solar energy system eligible for expedited review, only one inspection shall be required, which shall be done in a timely manner
If a small residential rooftop solar energy system fails inspection, a subsequent inspection is authorized

timeline_days.notes: Sanger Municipal Code Section 14-93(b)(6) states the building official shall 'administratively approve' a complete application but does not state an explicit day-count turnaround figure.

value.program_or_pathway: Small Residential Rooftop Solar Energy System expedited permitting (Sanger Municipal Code Section 14-93)
other_conditions: System must be installed on a single- or duplex-family dwelling
Solar panel/module array must not exceed the maximum legal building height as defined by the City of Sanger
